brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has proposed exploring cryptocurrency as a means to bypass potential international banking sanctions, Middle East Eye reported. The proposal has drawn sharp criticism from unnamed parties over concerns about diplomatic and financial isolation.

Details of the cryptocurrency plan and specific objections remain unclear from available information. Netanyahu's initiative follows broader international tensions surrounding Israeli policies and potential sanctions threats.

title: Netanyahu proposes cryptocurrency strategy to evade potential sanctions
